headline: Turkish car supplier makes big bet on Morocco with 25,000 square meter factory
summary: Turkish automotive supplier Fenese Otomotiv plans a production plant in Morocco covering 25,000 square meters. The site is meant to speed deliveries to customers in Europe, North Africa and the United States.
why: Auto suppliers that build plants near key customers can shorten supply chains and reduce logistics costs for carmakers.
